notes.title: Release of Multiplayer Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/a01e7924cb302a4d8c6e68c434117ad9c82297eb.jpg[/img]
Multiplayer has been one of the most requested features for the game since its initial launch back in 2020.

Around two years ago I started working on it in a [url=https://www.youtube.com/live/FpvD6p-BAlI]livestream[/url]. Pretty fun to look back at. A lot have happened since, some of you have been a part of the beta and some of you are seeing this for the first time now.

This update contains a lot more than "just" multiplayer, so lets go over some of the key changes.

[h2]Redesigned UI[/h2]
The first thing you will notice is the new UI. 

I needed a UI that could easier grow and adjust to the increasing need for adding new features etc.

I'm really happy with it so far and think it gives a nice fresh look for the game, without being too much in the way.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/b5d70b08f5b0d8b77296c99cd38a8151330b26b9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/8371b3ec58bd3b6a4aa3fc62d30dd161a1781356.jpg[/img]


[h2]Shells and Mortars[/h2]
Previously Shells and Mortars was only in the game via mods, originally created by Panini. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/bdae9b53e1dd1476324813751112c10c5f6bbfe9.jpg[/img]
I have now added native support for shells and mortars in the game and in the Mod Tools. 

This means the game now come with a few shells and mortars build-in, but more importantly, modders can create their own, which a few already did, like Amnestey. 

The reason I have not added more native shells and mortars to the game, is because I prioritized the modders. Instead of spending the time adding 10 more shells to the game natively, its much better for all spending the same time making it possible for modders to create their own, as that means many many many more shells than I could ever make and the quality is often higher too.
Amnestey already added more than 150 shells and a ton of mortars. So there is enough to try out already.


[h2]Multiplayer [/h2]
This one is kind of obvious, of cause there is multiplayer, but lets look at bit more into what that actually means.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/7609484634f37727203c6ae9c89c1db42709493f.jpg[/img]

Multiplayer sessions are hosted by players using [url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/1433-AD20-F11D-B71E]Steams Peer-to-peer Network[/url]. 
You can see a list of public hosts that you can join or you can create your own. 
A host can be either private or public, which you as a host decides. Often its a good idea to keep the host private if you only want to play with people you know.

To get your friends into the host you are currently on, you can either share the JoinCode (all hosts have a unique JoinCode) or you can invite them via Steams friend list if you have them there.
Alternatively, you can invite friends directly from the "Players" tab in-game - they do not even need to have the game running before joining!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/458ad8ff3035c2c7200c919c584a5467da6aa206.png[/img]

[h3]Mods[/h3]
The host decides what mods should be enabled. 
Talking about enabling mods, the flow to do so have changed a bit. This goes for both Singleplayer and Multiplayer.
The flow of what mods are enabled, both in Singleplayer and Multiplayer, have been changed a bit.

You still go into the Workshop to subscribe (which will download and install) the mods. 
However, you have to specifically select what mods you want in a particular game, as part of the creation of that game. It might take a little getting use to, but really, it's more intuitive to having to pick the mods as part of the creation of a game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/8371b3ec58bd3b6a4aa3fc62d30dd161a1781356.jpg[/img]


When you join a host, the game figures out what mods needs to be downloading/updated and enabled. 
No need to manually align anything with the host, just join and wait.

[h3]Characters[/h3]
As part of adding multiplayer I also added characters. There are some native characters/avatars in the game, but mod creators can also add their own, meaning you find even more characters in the Workshop.

These are some of the current characters in the game - I plan to add more soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/7fa81b010a78d03955a2ca4e304620bfeb12c5c0.jpg[/img]


[h3]Proximity voice chat[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/f4666cfa8b58f662187682b7dc55c5fcabf41c2d.jpg[/img]
To make the game more social and fun I have added proximity voice chat to the game. 
So hold 'C' or turn off Push-to-talk in Settings for open mic and start talk to your fellow players. Be aware, it's proximity chat, so you need to be close to hear each other. Further more, I made it so the voice gets muffled if you talk with someone behind a wall or other obstacle.


[h3]Dedicated server - in the works[/h3]
A lot have asked for dedicated server support and I have been working a bit on it. 
However, it was more important to me to get the game working good with player hosted sessions, as that was the original idea. However, I do see the need for dedicated server, just haven't spend enough time on it yet to make it good enough for release. So it will come later. 


[h2]Still Growing Workshop[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/cd4eae19fff2b9160674ec4aa47f5c75fe1971cf.jpg[/img]
The built-in Workshop is nothing new and it is still growing. It is becoming an more and more crucial part of the game. So if you have not yet checked out mods from the Workshop I highly recommend you do so - else you are missing out 🕺

The Workshop, [url=https://mod.io/g/fireworksmania]which is hosted on mod.io[/url], contains:
[list]
[*] 2000+ pieces of fireworks
[*] 50+ maps
[*] 100+ character
[/list]
As of writing, 2024-11-27, the Workshop have 12+ million mod downloads! 

So you guys really love mods! 🤓

[url=https://github.com/Laumania/FireworksMania.ModTools?tab=readme-ov-file#fireworks-mania---mod-tools]If you wanna give mod creation a try the Fireworks Mania Mod Tools is the place to go.[/url]

[h2]In case you wanna go back[/h2]
Not all mods are compatible with the new version and some might just wanna keep playing the legacy singleplayer version.

Fear not, you can get back to that version - but you need to be aware that you will not get any updates to anything on that version. No updates to the game itself and no mod updates. It's frozen in time as the game and Workshop was on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1079260/view/4521142923100471809]18th of Oct. 2024[/url].

Right Click Fireworks Mania -> Properties -> Betas -> Beta Participation -> v2024.10.5

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/31a492eec1102a665fb1edba230b8fe82060f190.png[/img]

If you want to get back to the latest released version you just set back the Beta Participation dropdown to "None". 

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
So with all these new things in this update, is the game now done, is development stopped, what will happen?

Don't worry 🤓

No, the game is not done. Actually the version you are getting now is just the first version. There are so many things I still want to add and I plan to keep working on the game, exactly as I have been doing for the past 5+ years.

See you in-game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/cd01a0165428d15b0ce35ed05650dc1eff9b5641.gif[/img]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/@laumania]YouTube[/url] | [url=https://www.twitch.tv/laumania]Twitch[/url] | [url=https://twitter.com/laumania]Twitter[/url] | [url=https://discord.gg/SzZD77p]Discord[/url]

- Enjoy!

notes.title: Languages, freely resizable & bug fixes
notes.notes:

notes.title: Faster map reloads and internal changes
notes.notes:
I'm constantly trying to improve the game in various ways and as you might have seen in my latest Developer News the next big feature I'm working on in 2023-2024 is multiplayer. 

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1079260/view/3645138266824812386

DISCLAIMER: I'm doing what I can to add multiplayer, but its not a feature I can promise will be in the game, just so we all are aware of that :)

v2023.2.1 brings a lot of internal changes, due to the potential future multiplayer feature, however as they are some internal technical things you shouldn't really experience a difference.

Some of the changes however do have an direct impact on things that you will see and experience.

One of these things are how sounds are handled. On first map load there will be no real difference on the load time, but on all subsequent map reloads you should see faster load times compared to previously.

Thats all for now, here I bring you the more technical change log to the ones that are interested.

Have a nice weekend.

[h2]Change log[/h2]

[h3]Added[/h3]
- Added a few new loading backgrounds showing of more Workshop map mods

[h3]Changed[/h3]
- Upgraded MasterAudio asset pack to 1.0.4
- Changed how MasterAudio and sounds in general work in the game. This should result in slightly faster loading times of maps and less MasterAudio related errors in the log
- Changed how the player is spawned at map start (changes to help support multiplayer later on)

[h3]Fixed[/h3]
- Fixed bug where PlayerSpawnLocationPrefabs rotation wasn't taken into account when the player was spawned

- Enjoy!

notes.title: Faster map listing and auto update mods
notes.notes:
v2023.1.6 bring some big improvement to handling of mods in general. Not a lot of eye-candy, but a lot of stuff under the hood that makes handling of mods much better.

[h2]Much faster map listing[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/f95cc5ef32b3ce775b5d3281776b2194fa343338.gif[/img]
I have improved the way custom maps are listed in the main menu so much that it's not even comparable to the old version. The more map mods you have installed the bigger the difference will be.
So what took like 5 min. to list before, now takes like 5-10 sec. So it's really a game changer!

[h2]Auto update of mods[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/42cfb2f59e79d99185683d04a0da858c3e89f989.gif[/img]
You would think that mods you subscribed to was automatically updated, right? Well, so did I, but it turned out that wasn't the case due to various technical reasons.
However, as a "side effects" of the optimized map listing, we now also have much more reliable mod updates. 
This is also a big clean and a game changer, as a lot of help requests on the Discord, often comes down players not having the latest version of a mod - and I can't blame them - as the game should update the mods automatically. It does now and it is a really nice feature.
As shown in the gif above, once you click the "Start" button in the MainMenu, the game quickly checks updates for all subscribed mods that are enabled.


That's all for now - hope you will have fun.

notes.title: Summer Update 2022
notes.notes:
As mentioned on my [url=https://www.youtube.com/laumania]YouTube Channel[/url] and in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1079260/discussions/0/3113647550058106312/]Roadmap[/url], 2022 is mainly about improving the quality of the game to make it "better" in general.

Todays update, v2022.6.3, brings various improvements to the game, some minor, some larger, but all to make the game better.

[previewyoutube=6jyu3Dyy644;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Mod Loading[/h1]
Shortly after the Workshop was added to the game in December 2021, it became clear that players loves mods. Mod creators also loves creating them, resulting in players having a lot of mods installed.

This is really a positive thing, except, the way the game originally loaded mods, wasn't optimal.

I have changed that now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/43fb54bdd6e28852200164ec91d86e7066920f99.jpg[/img]

You can now see progress of mods loading and the game should not really "freeze" anymore.

To spice it even more up, I have added new loading backgrounds (Thanks to Keltusar for creating these screenshots) and some ads for various mods. 
So now there is something interesting to look at while loading :)

Oh, and mods loads a bit faster now too.

[h1]Settings[/h1]
I have added various settings that have been requested by the community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/d0cefbe5c379253993506d648ddecb10134cbf52.png[/img] 

[h2]Camera shake[/h2]
Turns on/off camera shake. It adds to the feeling of mayhem to have it on, but some players don't what all that shaking, so now it can be turned off. I have later been asked if I could make this a slider, so you can turn it up and down to fit your needs. I'll consider it.

[h2]Auto despawn fireworks[/h2]
Per default used fireworks disappears after a while for performance reasons.
However, some players ([url=https://www.youtube.com/user/Superdreuzel]not mentioning any names[/url]) really like to see all their used fireworks stay in the map.
This is now possible by turning this off. 
Be aware that it will have an impact on the performance and of cause only works for fireworks that doesn't explode completely (firecrackers as example).

[h2]Explosion forces[/h2]
Turns on/off if explosions have an physics force effect on other objects. By turning this off you might get a bit better performance as objects will not fly around due to explosions. Good for when making shows.

[h2]Ignition forces[/h2]
Turn on/off if explosions can ignite other objects. Turning this off will stop chain reactions of explosions igniting other fireworks etc. Good to turn off when making shows.

Settings UI is starting to get a little cramped, but I didn't wanted to spend too much time on adding the UI for these new settings right now, as I'm planning to do a total UI rework later this year.

[h1]Pick-up and Throw[/h1]
For a long time a very requested feature has been to be able to pickup objects and throw them.
I have added this mechanic to the game now, but on top of picking up and throwing, you can also ignite it (if it's something that can be ignited of cause).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/ab8cd5d185e42ef0950d0308d547936dea6a3dcc.jpg[/img]

So go have fun with that - now don't do anything stupid, ok?

[h1]Workshop[/h1]
One note about this update is that some mods might break and thereby not work properly. 
Most mod creators have already fixed their mods and are ready to push updates to the Workshop now that this update is out for all. So give them a few days. 

[i][b]Pro Tip[/b]: You can force the game to download an update by unsubscribing and then subscribing to it again.
[/i]

[h1]...and more[/h1]
There are a ton of other minor changes. Most of them internal stuff you won't see.

However, one thing you will see, is the new "Codys Fireworks" store.
This building have been empty since game was released and now was the time to put something a bit more interesting there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/5a547e8e2de7fd719e8ef13f8d3db95d7e9d6049.jpg[/img]

So why is it called "Codys Fireworks" you might ask. Well, I had to call it something and I remembered [url=https://www.youtube.com/post/UgwlUF5FFXqzXSPOYUF4AaABCQ?app=desktop]CodyBPyrotechnics once posted an old drawing he did when he was a kid[/url].

notes.title: Major update dropping on 16th of December
notes.notes:
On the 16th of December 2021, around 16:00 (04:00PM) CET, the next major update for Fireworks Mania will drop.

Christmas comes early this year :)

[h1]Mods & workshop[/h1]
In case you haven't heard it, the biggest change in this update is the mod and workshop support - so what does that mean?

Mod and workshop support enables the community (modders) to create their own fireworks to be used in the game. Once its ready they can share with the the community via the mod.io workshop.

For you as a player this means you can now get tons of more items in your inventory to play around with  - with new ones being added every day/week, thanks to some awesome modders we have in the Fireworks Mania community!

Over the last few weeks where mod support have been on the experimental branch, modders have managed to publish no less than 58 mods!

You can browse the workshop here: [url=https://fireworksmania.mod.io/]fireworksmania.mod.io[/url]

There is a workshop directly in the game where you subscribe to the mods you want to install. So installing and uninstalling mods is literally as simple as clicking a button in the game.

I showed of how it basically work in this dev log if you are interested.
[previewyoutube=NpHJMKgOuFQ;full][/previewyoutube]

I'm really excited to see what modders will create over time as I expand what is possible with the mod tools and what players will do and build with it - I'm foreseeing a blast of a New Years this year :)

[h1]Surprises?[/h1]
I'm not saying I have added a bit more to the game than mod and workshop support, but I might have added a bit more than mod and workshop support to the game.

You will see on the 16th ;)

- Enjoy!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1079260/Fireworks_Mania__An_Explosive_Simulator/

notes.title: 4th of July Update - v2021.6.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/e64e9ebbe6a956f9477906676617cb27f1758d23.gif[/img]

I know "4th of July" is only a thing in the states (USA), but it seems you guys take all opportunities you can get to fire of fireworks, so here is another one!

... and while we are at it with the celebration - lets do a 20% SUMMER SALE :D

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1079260/Fireworks_Mania__An_Explosive_Simulator/

[h1]Changelog - Top 5[/h1]

[h2]More fireworks and 4th of July decorations[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/96d448404dcfe6b5de75f6f8f40d0643625b6ebe.png[/img]
"4th of July" is approaching and being the creator of a fireworks game, I thought it made good sense to release a bigger update around 4th of July.

[i]In case you don't know, "4th of July" is the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Independence_Day_(United_States)]Independence day in USA[/url], among other things, its celebrated by firing off fireworks.
[/i]

Therefore, I have been up all night, putting up "4th of July" decorations through out the game. 
They don't really do much, but I hope it gives a "celebration feeling" - even to none Americans.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/32a6414d71c5ecfd3d01c40b2fa284691240573d.png[/img]

Also, I added a bunch of new fireworks, like:
[list]
[*] 4th of July themed cakes
[*] Smoke bombs (different colors)
[*] The first fountain in the game
[*] New Tubes
[*] ... and a few more things
[/list]
[i][b]NOTE[/b]: The "4th of July" themed decorations is a time limited thing and will be removed shortly after 4th of July. However, the fireworks are here to stay.[/i]

[h2]Blueprints (save/load)[/h2]
Back in December 2020 when I launched Fireworks Mania, the top requested feature was the ability to save/load/share your firework shows. 
Therefore, this was on the top of my list - [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ebyXUbKjnxY&list=PLfRfKfCcFo_s49jOqbJv9rZBOHAdBLgFf]as shown in my devlogs on YouTube[/url]. 

It turned out to take a bit longer than I expected, why it wasn't ready before now. 
Even though it works as its being released now, I'm sure I will keep updating it - but at least it can do the minimum now - which I assume will change the game a lot as you can now build really awesome shows, as you can save, try, load, fix, save and retry.

I call it "blueprints", which was the best name I and [url=https://discord.gg/SzZD77p]the community at Discord[/url] could come up with.

Essentially what you can do is to save and load all the things you have spawned, meaning fireworks and props. The reason I write this, is to make it clear that it's not the entire map that is saved, only the stuff you spawned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/e0652a2f62d89f581fad1f7cbb7aea806f13d674.png[/img]
The first place you will see this, is in the Tools Menu (Q), where you have a "Quick Save" and "Quick Load" option now. They do exactly what you would expect, they saves the currently spawned objects in the current map and load them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/467008173eef9a207ad6dfeac1e7fe567c8f041d.png[/img]
Once you are satisfied or just want to save what you currently have, you can open the "Blueprint" part of the Inventory (TAB) and "Save As" to give your blueprint a name.
This is also where you can load previously saved blueprints.

[i][b]NOTE[/b]: Blueprints are saved as individual files. By clicking the "Open Folder" you will get to the "blueprints folder" where you can see, rename, delete or copy the blueprint files. This is also where you can take a file from and send to a friend. Your friend can then open the same folder and place the file in there and see your show. 
In the future I would like to make this a part of the Steam Workshop to make this much easier, but this is how it is for now.[/i]

[h2]Performance[/h2]
For some reason a lot of you really want to push the limits in Fireworks Mania and see how much your computer and the game can take - I just made your life a bit harder - as I have made some performance optimization that should (I hope :P) make it less likely to have these "[i]0 FPS for a couple of minutes[/i]" moments. 

Yes you can get it down in FPS for sure, but it should do a better job trying to make it harder for you :)

[h2]Unlockables[/h2]
Even though this is really just a sandbox/simulator game for now, with no real gameplay or goals, a lot of you like hunting for Easter eggs and explore the maps.
So I thought, why not make something to hunt for - so I have added "Unlockables" to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/4377c7abbfef7dc6e09ed418c51b2f6bbb8caabd.png[/img]

Each blue question mark either permanent or temporarily unlocks an item in the Inventory - so now there is a little to hunt for.
Please try not to spoil too much to your friends - will ya? :D 
The locations of these unlockables are strategically and carefully selected with supervision from my kids :P

[h1]New map - Flat map[/h1]
Another very requested feature from you guys was a flat map. 
Therefore I have added a new map called "Flat Map".

Its a map, it is flat and it is.....well, that's it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/0a86751d9c79d7dacc9157a15c5c6ef7cf9ab4b2.png[/img]

[h1]Enjoy![/h1]
That was the Top 5 changes, however there are more minor things, some under the hood that you as a player don't directly see, but also a couple of things that impact you directly, like the "FPS Limiter" in Settings, where you can limit the FPS in the game to get a more smooth and consistent experience, ex. when recording.

Enjoy the update and let me know what you think :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1079260/Fireworks_Mania__An_Explosive_Simulator/

[h1]Still here?[/h1]
Ok, so you are still here... impressive. I assume that means you have a fair bit of interest in Fireworks Mania and maybe in some behind the scene stuff. If not, you can skip this.

I only post here on Steam when the game is actually updated. All the in progress stuff (which you can actually often try out and help test), I tell about on my [url=https://www.youtube.com/laumania]YouTube channel "Laumania"[/url].

So if you want to follow along as I create the game and want to know what's coming, subscribing to my channel is a good idea. [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ebyXUbKjnxY&list=PLfRfKfCcFo_s49jOqbJv9rZBOHAdBLgFf]For starters you can watch some of my devlogs, if interested[/url].

If you want to interact with more than 2000 other Fireworks Mania fans, you can consider [url=https://discord.gg/SzZD77p]joining my Discord[/url].

If you haven't seen my video about how all this started, it's right here.

That must be it for now - this post turned out much longer than expected, sorry :)

- Enjoy!

I need to send a BIG THANKS to the awesome community around Fireworks Mania - because the majority of these translations are their work. 
As I plan to keep adding a ton of stuff to the game, translations will be an ongoing thing, why I have setup a "Localization Team" in my Discord that are helping with exactly that!

Thanks guys/girls, you are awesome! (You can see the names under Credits in the game)

You can join the Discord too, if you want to be a active part of the community.
[url=https://discord.gg/SzZD77p]Join the Discord here[/url]


[h2]Change log - v2021.1.1[/h2]

WHAT'S CHANGED
- Added localization (translations) to the game. The game will per default pick your language if it's supported. Alternatively you can change the langauge in Settings
- Updated Credits UI
- The rotation speed have increased. This is especially visible when you "snap rotate". Before it was so smooth/slow that players didn't noticed that it was actually snapping

BUGS
- Fixed bug where a rocket wouldn't start flying in some cases if you kept igniting it
- Fixed collider issue on wired fence at Ranch so you can actually interact with objects on the other side

[h2]What's up next?[/h2]
I develop this game very agile, meaning I try and adapt to what happens in the community.
I know you all want a lot of different things, but it seems like a save/load feature is something that the majority really wants. So that's what I'm looking into in the coming weeks/months.
I expect this one to be a lot more complicated than localization, so have some patience.

Lets see what I figure out :)

notes.title: Minor demo update - v2020.7.3-demo
notes.notes:
Summer vacation time is over and I'm back at the regular schedule of Fireworks Mania game dev time in the evenings.

My guess is that this will be the last update of the demo for a while, as I go back to focus on getting the full game ready for its initial release in december 2020.
I plan go get back and do dev logs again on [url=https://www.youtube.com/laumania]Youtube[/url] and also post them here, but how often and how much I don't know - time will tell.

[i]If you missed some of my previous dev logs you can [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nE5KLpXjT6E&list=PLfRfKfCcFo_s49jOqbJv9rZBOHAdBLgFf&index=3]find them on this play list[/url].
[/i]

Lets get to the more fun part - the change log for this update. 
As the title says, it's a minor update, so don't get your expectations up too high.

[h1]Changelog[/h1] 

[h2]UI[/h2]
Some players complained about the tooltips being too hard to see, at least the "tab" button. 
The reason for this is that the images were forced to the same width, which resulted in wider key graphics to be fairly hard to see, depending on the resolution.

That has been fixed now - and for some reason it took me much longer to figure out how to fix than I care to admit :P

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/091adc4be852a54934189b33b8dc512657dfef26.png[/img]

[h2]Fireworks[/h2]
The explosion force of the fireworks have been turned back up. It got turned down too much in last update, due to some changes to the logic. This wasn't intended!
So now, things starts flying around again.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/e9390ff3281c9cdcae41d2060740471f76781406.gif[/img]
[i](No flamingos was hurt during this test - they died right after of natural causes)[/i]

[h2]Audio[/h2]
All the UI sounds from buttons have been turned down a bit.

Sometimes if many of the same type of fireworks were ignited at the same time, some of the explosions were missing sounds. I made a few changes that should minimize the risk of this happening.

The [i]jump[/i] sound of the player have been changed and is less annoying now.

[h2]Other[/h2]
The way object are outlined are now a little different. The object is self doesn't get a tint of a color anymore, only the outline is visible. I think this looks better and don't block your view and the old version could do some times.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/47b3297e6b1d47ddbdaaa32097f08e8de7ca7497.gif[/img]

Some potential performance improvements have been added, so the game should run just a tiny bit better now.

Thats all for this update - enjoy and have fun!
